DPT fused map (A3.3 info layer for depth-anything-v2-large and -3-large-1.1): 'nearest stride 16' resolved as the fusion output whose side is closest to 224/16 = 14, i.e. the 16x16 map (stride 14); index and sizes recorded in the feature meta.

sam3 (and sam3.1 design): token maps (72x72 at the 1008-px processor size) mapped to 16x16 at extraction with the harness grid rule (before the float16 cast) instead of at probe time.
